title: Dark Night Clouds of Suspicion
next_chapter_hook: The cracks on the turtle shell's surface spread like a spider's web under the moonlight, as if some ominous premonition was coming true—Chen Ji knew that the bond between him and the Tianji Record was collapsing in a way he could not bear.

text.content: At the third watch of the midnight hour, the night wind from Tianqing Sect Back Mountain carried the scent of pine resin and cold dew. Chen Ji tucked the jade pendant close to his body, and the moment his fingertips touched the Tianji Record Fragment, a familiar chill spread from his palm. He draped on his gray cloth robe, completely merging himself into the night. Sect insider—this thought had coiled like a venomous snake in his heart for three whole days. Now, he was finally about to lift this veil.

Elder Zhang Shen's courtyard lay deep within the Bamboo Grove on the eastern side of the sect, usually the most secluded place. Chen Ji crept along the base of the wall, his breathing pressed extremely low, just like a cat prowling for food at night. His footsteps made virtually no sound on the blue stone slabs—skills honed over three years as a servant disciple. No one pays attention to a废物's movements, so naturally, no one guards against him.

dialogue.content: (The Tianji Record Fragment grew slightly warm, Mo Xiansheng's hoarse voice echoed in his mind) Lad, are you certain you want to investigate? Old man told you before, the sect runs deep—once you see certain truths, there's no turning back.

text.content: Chen Ji sneered in his heart. No turning back? From the moment he transmigrated into this废物's body, there had been no path back. The truth behind his sister's disappearance, the parasites within the sect, and that jade pendant whose material was identical to the turtle shell—all of this had to be investigated. His fingers gently stroked the Tianji Record as he said quietly, "If sir has time to warn me, might as well tell me what you know about Zhang Shen."

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a moment) Zhang Shen, Outer Sect Elder, specifically in charge of servant disciple affairs. Seems to have no power or influence, but actually... thirty years ago he was a hot candidate competing with Ling Yuan for the sect master position. Later, for unknown reasons, he voluntarily withdrew, choosing to hide his talents ever since. Do you think someone who could let go of such ambition could truly be a废物?

text.content: A rustling sound suddenly came from deep within the bamboo grove. Chen Ji immediately lowered his stance, hiding behind a cluster of banana plants. His pupils constricted sharply—Zhang Shen's withered figure was emerging from the courtyard, followed by two black-robed figures. Under the moonlight, their robe hems were embroidered with a spreading black crow—the mark of the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path!

Chen Ji's heart rate surged, but he forced himself to remain calm. Countless times over three years he'd been stepped on by others, long ago learning to control his emotions in any situation. He quietly adjusted his angle, peering through the gaps in the bamboo leaves at this clandestine meeting that should not exist. Fragments drifted to his ears—"three-year deadline approaching," "heavenly secrets fragment," "key"... each word pierced his heart like a needle.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji's pupils slightly narrowed) Three-year deadline... heavenly secrets fragment... Could they too be searching for the Tianji Record?

text.content: Zhang Shen's hoarse laughter drifted in the night wind: "Rest assured, that kid is merely a废物. Even if he had some fortuitous encounter, he can't make any waves. It's Lin Yuan the sect master over there... once the three-year deadline arrives, if the Tianji Record still isn't complete, that old不死 won't be able to sit still anymore." Chen Ji's fingernails nearly dug into his palms—Sect Master? Old不死? He suddenly realized he'd been under surveillance all along, and the surveillance was coming from the highest levels of the sect.

Just then, a gust of night wind suddenly swept up, stirring the bamboo leaves above Chen Ji's head. That subtle rustling was especially glaring in the silent night. Zhang Shen's gaze turned sharp in an instant, his aged voice piercing like cold ice: "Who's there!" Chen Ji felt all his hair stand on end, a razor-sharp spiritual sense sweeping toward where he hid.

choice.prompt: In the instant spiritual sense swept over, Chen Ji had to make a decision immediately—

choices.text: Conceal aura and gamble on luck
choices.description: Bet that Zhang Shen's spiritual sense cannot penetrate the bamboo grove's cover, bet that his breath-suppression technique honed through three years of patient cultivation will suffice.
choices.risk_hint: If discovered, will face encirclement by the Demonic Path and sect insider
choices.process_label: 你屏息凝神，将存在感压缩到极致

text.content: In that instant, Chen Ji urged the Tianji Record Fragment, a warmth spreading from his chest through his four limbs and hundred meridians. He sensed fine patterns emerging on the turtle shell's surface, automatically helping him conceal all aura. The next moment, that blade-like spiritual sense swept past him—seemingly passing over a stone, without the slightest hesitation.

"Hmph, just bamboo leaves moved by wind." Zhang Shen withdrew his spiritual sense, coldly snorting, "Demonic Path friends, remember to clear the surroundings before taking action next time—we don't want those orthodox hypocrites to catch our柄." The black-robed figure let out a sinister laugh, and all three turned, vanishing into the depths of the night.

choices.description: Follow them quietly as they leave—if can overhear even more crucial intelligence, taking some risks is worthwhile.
choices.risk_hint: May be discovered, and will consume Heavenly Fate
choices.process_label: 你悄无声息地跟上，决定赌一把

text.content: Chen Ji gritted his teeth and activated the Tianji Record to perceive danger three breaths ahead. The turtle shell grew slightly warm, and a blurry image flashed through his mind—three people would arrive at the entrance of the Forbidden Grounds in thirty breaths, and the guards would only have a five-breath window during their shift change. He calculated the distance and began racing through the shadows.

He pressed himself behind the artificial rock and heard Zhang Shen say to the black-robed figure: "That girl Chen Nian is locked away in the Heavenly Secrets Valley. After three years, her divine soul will be extracted—to serve as the final key. The conditions your Holy Sect agreed to, this old man remembers them all." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, and he nearly crushed his back molars—Chen Nian, his sister who had been missing for years!

choices.text: Retreat immediately upon seeing the situation turn unfavorable
choices.description: Preserve the青山(green mountains) and there will be firewood—今夜的情报已经足够多，没必要冒更大的险。
choices.visible_reward: Preserve oneself, the intelligence is already shocking enough
choices.process_label: 你决定暂时撤退，保存实力

text.content: Chen Ji quietly retreated three steps, each step precisely avoiding dry branches and fallen leaves. His movements flowed like clouds and water, as if he had rehearsed them countless times. However, the moment he turned, the blue stone slab beneath his feet emitted a slight crisp sound—the slippery moss left by last night's rotting leaves.

"A mouse." Zhang Shen's voice was cold as frozen ice, and a sharp sword qi cleaved through the air. Chen Ji dodged sideways, the sword qi grazing past his ear and slicing off a few strands of hair. That was close! He dared not linger any longer, racing away under the cover of night until he finally stopped at his own dilapidated hut.

Chen Ji leaned against the door, his chest heaving violently. Everything just now replayed in his mind like a slideshow—Zhang Shen, the Demonic Path Holy Sect, the three-year deadline, Pavilion Master Ling... and that name that made his heart ache: Chen Nian. His sister, the girl taken away by the Holy Sect, was actually imprisoned in the Heavenly Secrets Valley, tightly entangled with the secret of the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out again, carrying a rare gravity) Boy, do you now understand why this old man always told you to endure? The Tianji Record is a chess game arranged by the Heavenly Dao, and the moment you obtained it, you were already drawn into waters deeper than sect conflicts. As for Chen Nian's matter... this old man can tell you, she does have a connection to the Tianji Record, but the price... you cannot bear it yet.

text.content: Chen Ji slowly drew out the Tianji Record Fragment, wanting to see what connection his sister had with this turtle shell. However, the moment he gazed at the turtle shell, his heart tightened sharply—on the surface of the turtle shell, several fine cracks had appeared at some point. They were barely visible in the moonlight, like some ominous prophecy being fulfilled. Mo Xiansheng had said, the more complete the Tianji Record, the stronger the fatal backlash of fate—could he have already reached this point?

choice.prompt: Facing the cracks on the turtle shell and Mo Xiansheng's warning, Chen Ji needed to make a decision—

choices.text: Interrogate Mo Xiansheng about information regarding his sister
choices.description: Regardless of the cost, he needed to know what connection his sister had with the Tianji Record. Even if this only caused him more pain, he could not pretend ignorance.
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng might consequently reveal some truths that are unbearable for you
choices.process_label: 你握紧龟甲，逼视着那道虚影

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji gritted his teeth) Chen Nian is the Heavenly Fate Lock Key, isn't she? Her being taken was not an accident—it was deliberately arranged by someone! Tell me, what will happen to her in the Heavenly Secrets Valley?

text.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently and was silent for a long while before speaking: "Lock Key... indeed, her destiny is perfectly aligned with the Tianji Record. As for what will happen—when the three-year period ends, her divine soul will be extracted and fused into the core of the Tianji Record, used to complete this fragmented turtle shell. This is the fate of every generation's prophet, and the price that those chosen by the Heavenly Dao cannot escape."

choices.description: Acting rashly now will only expose oneself. One must first stabilize their position and scheme secretly. There is still time before the three-year deadline. He needs a more comprehensive plan.
choices.visible_reward: Maintain composure to facilitate subsequent scheming
choices.risk_hint: May affect the timing of triggering certain subsequent events
choices.process_label: 你深吸一口气，将愤怒压入心底最深处

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze gradually cooled, the fury that threatened to shatter his reason was pressed down into the depths of his heart, bit by bit. The three-year deadline, Ling Yuan's ambition, Zhang Shen's betrayal, his sister's crisis—all of these had to be resolved step by step. He tucked the Turtle Shell back into his chest, fingertips gently stroking those newly emerging cracks.

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng sighed) Good lad, to maintain composure under such circumstances—you'll go further than this old man anticipated. Since that's the case, this old man will tell you something—Zhang Shen is not the mastermind; he is merely Ling Yuan's piece. The true chess player, from beginning to end, is that old fox sitting in the sect master's seat.

text.content: Ling Yuan. This name reverberated repeatedly in Chen Ji's heart. The old sect master of Tianqing Sect, who on the surface had shown considerable care for this废物 Outer Disciple, even publicly stating such words as 'background doesn't matter, character is fundamental.' So all of this was pretense—he was raising a venomous worm, waiting for the Tianji Record Fragment to surface on its own. And he, Chen Ji, was merely a piece about to ripen in the eyes of that old fox.

The night grew deep, the sound of the watchman's bamboo clapper drifting in through the window. Chen Ji sat on the dilapidated bed, fingers rhythmically tapping against his knee. His mind, however, raced at full speed, analyzing all the information obtained tonight. Zhang Shen had connections with the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path—this could be leveraged well; Ling Yuan was manipulating from behind the scenes, meaning the sect's upper echelons were far more complex than they appeared; and his sister Chen Nian was imprisoned in Tianji Valley—this meant he had to quicken his pace, finding a method to break the局 before the three-year deadline arrived.

He took out the Tianji Record Fragment once more. This time, he didn't rush to use it, but carefully examined those newly emerged cracks. They were like some kind of warning, or perhaps some kind of countdown. Each time he used the Tianji Record's ability, fate's backlash would deepen by one degree; and with each backlash, those cracks became more pronounced. Chen Ji suddenly realized a question—tonight, the Turtle Shell automatically helped him conceal his presence. Did this count as 'using' the Tianji Record? Were these cracks the price of Heavenly Fate consumption, or some more terrifying omen?

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng seemed to sense his doubt) Stop overthinking. The Turtle Shell's automatic protective function doesn't count toward consumption. These cracks are... something else. Perhaps you've drawn closer to the truth, or perhaps Heaven's Way has already taken notice of you. Lad, from tonight onward, you'd better be even more careful—because those marked by Heaven's Way never meet good ends.

text.content:
Chen Ji tucked away the Turtle Shell, tilting his head to gaze at the bright moon beyond the window. Moonlight flowed like water, spilling across his tranquil features, revealing no emotional fluctuations whatsoever. Three years ago, when he had transmigrated into this废物 body, he had thought this was merely a simple trash-to-treasure counterattack script. Now he understood—he had been drawn into a shocking chess game in which even Heaven's Way participated. And he, was both a piece and potentially the one who could break the局—as long as he could crush all his enemies before the three-year deadline arrived.

Those cracks on the Turtle Shell's surface flickered in the moonlight, as if some ominous premonition was being fulfilled—Chen Ji knew that the bond between himself and the Tianji Record was collapsing in a way he could not bear.
